Application Security

Смягчение атак повторной передачи

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Security controls implemented to detect and prevent replay attacks, where previously valid data transmissions are maliciously resent to gain unauthorized access or privileges.

Operational example

Replay Attack Mitigation is critical for APIs transmitting sensitive data, requiring mechanisms such as nonces or timestamps to ensure message uniqueness.
